- Initial public release of Music Generator Free Easy v1.0.0.

- Seamless cloud-rendered MP4s in 20–40 seconds—no timeline editing or export settings required.
- Automatic onboarding: connects using your token or provides a free trial token with 100 credits.
- Supports uploads, audio/video track management, credits check, export, and multilingual commands.
